title: Finite etale extension of the punctured group-order root pullback
statement: Let i:U→L be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], G a finite group and W→U a finite etale G-torsor [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Let R be a commutative regular ring [def-weil-regular-scheme], φ:Spec R→L and f∈R a nonzerodivisor with R/(f) regular. Assume |G| is invertible in R. Let β:U×_L Spec R≅D(f) commute with projections [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let barY:Spec Ω→Spec R be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. Put H=the canonical affine pointed-neighbourhood coordinate-ring colimit [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], and let b:R→H induce its canonical structural morphism [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. Put g=b(f), n=|G|, A=H[T]/(T^n-g), N=Spec A, q:N→Spec H the structural morphism and V=D(g)⊂N. There is a scheme E and a finite etale surjective morphism p:E→N, together with an isomorphism delta:E×_N V ≅ W×_L V over V, where the morphism V→L is V→N→Spec H→Spec R→L. Neither a section of p nor a section of the punctured cover is asserted.

proof.text: Factor the base morphism of the punctured root scheme through the open D(f) via beta. The pullback of i is an isomorphism there: its further base change is an open immersion and surjective by the range formula. Pullback pasting then identifies the displayed cover projection as the torsor base change followed by an isomorphism, proving it finite, etale, and surjective.

If g is a unit, V=N. Use the original punctured pullback as E, composed with the inclusion of V into N, now an isomorphism. The pullback-fst isomorphism supplies delta; pullback.condition proves the projection identity.

If g is nonunit, use the finite normalization model and root divisor supplied by strict_hensel_root_purity_data. Apply exists_finite_etale_extension_of_regular_integral_divisor. Compose pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict p V with the inverse purity isomorphism and the finite-model identification. The projection equation follows from the inverse identities and pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict_hom_morphismRestrict.

Equip the small strict-henselization ring H with the R-algebra structure induced by b. Apply strictHenselization_indEtale_of_affine_chart to the identity chart Spec R, the identity spectrum isomorphism, and hb. Take its filtered etale algebra colimit presentation and map it to R-modules. Every stage is flat because it is etale, and ModuleCat.flat_of_colimitPresentation makes H flat over R. Flatness preserves injectivity of multiplication by f in H. The positive-degree monic root algebra is free over H, so multiplication by g stays injective there. Localization away from g is injective; denseRange_comap_iff_ker_le_nilRadical and the localization-away range formula show V is dense. Torsor surjectivity, delta, and pullback.condition show V is contained in the image of p. Since p is finite its image is closed. A closed set containing a dense set is the whole spectrum, proving p surjective.

theorem GaloisCover.strict_hensel_root_finite_etale_model
    {L U : Scheme.{u}} (i : U ⟶ L)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (W : GaloisCover G U)
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : Spec R ⟶ L) (f : R)
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : R))
    [IsRegularRing R] (hf : IsSMulRegular R f)
    [IsRegularRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f})]
    (β : pullback i φ ≅ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f))
    (hβ : β.hom ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) = pullback.snd i φ)
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (barY : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec R)
    (b : R ⟶ strictHenselizationRing barY)
    (hb : Spec.map b = strictHenselizationStructuralMap barY) :
    let H := strictHenselizationRing barY
    let g := b.hom f
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H A g)
    ∃ (E : Scheme.{u}) (p : E ⟶ N),
      IsFinite p ∧ Etale p ∧ Function.Surjective p ∧
      ∃ δ : pullback p V.ι ≅ pullback (W.π ≫ i) (V.ι ≫ q ≫ Spec.map b ≫ φ),
        δ.hom ≫ pullback.snd (W.π ≫ i) (V.ι ≫ q ≫ Spec.map b ≫ φ) =
          pullback.snd p V.ι
